hypotheses.claim: Normalizing the generalized savings by the single global depot-distance scale (never per-pair d0i+d0j) while adding a mild radial-asymmetry term mu*|d0i-d0j| and a dimensionless capacity-fill reward beta*(q_i+q_j)/Q will lower mean tour length on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 below the current 16.0861 (relocate_2opt), with the largest relative gains on tight-capacity and clustered instances where fragmented last-routes arise; per-pair local normalization would instead destroy the radial priority order and must be avoided.

next_search_advice.direction: Adopt the KB-verified generalized Clarke-Wright scoring family: score(i,j) = (d0i + d0j - lam*d(i,j) + mu*|d0i - d0j|) / mean(d[0,1:]) + beta*clip((q_i+q_j)/Q,0,1) with lam~1.00-1.15, mu~0.08-0.15, beta~0.05-0.15, keeping relocate_2opt postprocess; search for a capacity-fill-aware radial correction that improves the tight-capacity clustered regimes.
